main_issue: Who completes Agent D's unfinished pitch section for Thursday while D attends the wake: D working tonight, or A taking over with help from B and C.

A-B.evidence: A asks B to review (T9, T11); B agrees to review tomorrow afternoon (T10).

A-C.evidence: C agrees to help with slides after finishing their own part (T12, T19); A accepts and plans around that (T18).

A-D.evidence: A rejected D's offer to work tonight (T7, T14). D yielded (T15), thanked everyone (T20), and A said 'We'll handle it' (T21).

B-C.evidence: Both said they could not take on more (T4, T5), then both agreed to A's plan (T10, T12, T19). They did not address each other.

B-D.evidence: B said little to D. B's review role (T10) fits the arrangement D accepted at T15 and T20.

C-D.evidence: D worried about C being behind (T13, T15); C replied 'Don't worry about my part' (T17). D then accepted the arrangement (T20).
